recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a man with a short afro and mustache, wearing a formal suit and lavender tie, set against a dramatic diagonal light beam and a soft-focus smoky background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's hand resting on chin creates a triangular frame for the face
Diagonal light beam separates the dark subject from the dark background
Lavender tie and pocket square coordinate with the pink script typography
High-contrast lighting emphasizes facial features and skin texture
coreInvariants: Diagonal light beam from top-left to bottom-right
Subject in a formal suit with a visible tie and pocket square

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-up portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile, positioned slightly above the horizontal center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the hand down to the tie, then moves along the diagonal light beam to the top-right typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, smoky areas in the top-left and bottom-right corners provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the suit and background shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale blue in the diagonal light beam.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lavender and pink in the tie, pocket square, and script lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the light beam and shadows; low saturation except for the targeted lavender accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool-toned purples and warm skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Extremely long, sweeping ascenders and descenders
Continuous fluid strokes with rounded terminals
Uniform line weight throughout the script
Overlapping loops that create a signature-like appearance
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature oversized, circular flourishes
Lowercase letters are compact and tightly connected
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a fluid, organic script and a rigid, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, functional look of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with a mustache and afro in a lavender suit, hand on chin, against a dark background with a bright diagonal white light beam from top-left to bottom-right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a pink monolinear script signature in the top right and a small white sans-serif all-caps title in the top left.

verificationChecks: Is there a diagonal light beam?
Is the subject wearing a lavender tie?
Is the secondary text in the top-left corner?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the diagonal light beam
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any brand logos or record label marks
Exact wording of the original titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hand pose looks natural and not distorted
Check that the script does not obscure the face
Verify the diagonal light beam has soft, feathered edges
Confirm the color palette remains consistent across clothing and text
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Diagonal Light Beam + Lavender Accents + Signature Script Overlay
